description: Server-driven conversation mode: the server adds a 'conversation' flag to the playAudio command to tell the device whether to keep the microphone open for a follow-up turn (no wake word) until N ms of silence (config: conversationTimeoutMs). No device flag required; the server keeps one LLM session per echo connection for multi-turn memory.
Add support for multiple screens & temperature sensor with 'Echo dasboard' + JSON text commands
add recorded audio into PSRAM buffer before sending to server to avoid problem with network latency. Same for received audio.
new options to set serverip and wake word accuracy through websocket.
first version with ESP32HomeAssistant library config
